confusion_boundaries.rule: A bicycle frame owns tubes and joints; an image frame belongs to composition. Neither word alone proves the other.

confusion_boundaries.confusion: fork assembly / tuning fork / branching form
confusion_boundaries.rule: A wheel-retaining bicycle fork has two blades and axle interfaces; tuning-fork props and lightning branches have different owners and connections.

confusion_boundaries.confusion: rigid tube / garment leg tube / anatomy
confusion_boundaries.rule: A bicycle member is not a trouser tube or body limb; garment construction and anatomical continuity retain their specialized roles.
A hinge or pivot is a bounded connection regardless of its current angle. Opening, folding, gripping and adjustment events require their own supported effects.
The candidates commit visible parts and joints only. Aluminum, steel, wood, fabric chemistry, coatings and repeated surface relief are separate claims.

confusion_boundaries.confusion: owned assembly / external contact or placement
confusion_boundaries.rule: The joint belongs to the identified object. Hand contact, wheel-on-floor placement and tripod-mounted capture cannot stand in for its internal assembly.
External joints and distinct parts must be visible. Bearings, manufacturing process, mechanical strength and performance cannot be certified from this geometry.

sources.title: Trek bicycle owner manual: Bike diagrams, printed page 3-2 / PDF page 60
sources.supports: The manufacturer diagram identifies top tube, down tube, head tube, headset, fork and hub and shows their distinct locations. The authored example selects a conventional tubular frame; other bicycle layouts need their own component review.
sources.access: Opened official PDF; inspected local rendering of PDF page 60.

sources.title: SRAM RockShox Domain technical manual: Anatomy and fork removal
sources.supports: The manual separates steerer, crown, upper tubes and lower legs. Its removal description places the axle through the hub and into the fork dropout. This supports the hub-to-fork interface without claiming that all forks use this model’s dual crowns.
sources.access: Opened official PDF; read PDF pages 8-9 through extracted text.

sources.title: CITTA umbrella manufacturer: Parts of an umbrella
sources.supports: Distinguishes canopy, radial ribs, connecting stretchers, central shaft and runner. Joint arrangement and panel/rib counts vary with the model. Materials and wind resistance require separate evidence.
sources.access: Opened manufacturer component guide and read sections on ribs, stretchers and shaft.

sources.title: IKEA UTRUSTA hinge assembly instructions AA-845308-3
sources.supports: The illustrated assembly shows the recessed door-side hinge cup, articulated arm and cabinet-side mounting connection. It supports a concealed cup-hinge example rather than treating every door hinge as this design.
sources.access: Opened official two-page PDF; rendered and visually inspected page 2.

sources.title: Leatherman Raptor Rescue official product and maintenance FAQ
sources.supports: The manufacturer identifies a screw at the main shear pivot. The example retains a visible central pivot and separate blade/handle members, without importing rescue use, folding hardware or performance claims.
sources.access: Opened official product page; read main-pivot FAQ.

sources.title: Fiskars Cooking catalogue 2026: Classic scissors
sources.supports: The manufacturer describes handles attached onto the blades, and distinguishes reversed blade layout for left-handed scissors. This supports each blade’s own handle attachment; no handedness is selected for the authored example.
sources.access: Read official manufacturer PDF search extract.

sources.title: Manfrotto 190 three-section tripod with head
sources.supports: Describes the center column mechanism in the top casting, separate leg-angle selectors and clamps for individual leg sections. Structural joints are distinct from camera framing, motion and claims of stability.
sources.access: Opened official product page and read product overview. Later repeated fetch returned HTTP 429; initial primary-source extract was available.

sources.title: RIDGID Heavy-Duty Straight Pipe Wrenches
sources.supports: Identifies the housing, I-section handle, floating hook jaw, heel jaw and adjustment nut as separate components. The example retains their physical assembly, with no specified material, force or gripping performance.
sources.access: Opened official product page including component description and FAQ.

sources.title: RIDGID Straight Pipe Wrench parts list
sources.supports: Official parts sheet lists handle, nut, pin, heel jaw, spring and hook jaw separately. This is supporting component inventory, not permission to invent hidden internals.
sources.access: Opened official linked PDF and read component labels. Local download returned HTTP 403; no claim of a locally inspected rendering.
